info.name: wger Workout Manager – QA Test Suite
info.description:
API test suite for the wger Workout Manager REST API ([https://wger.de/api/v2/](https://wger.de/api/v2/)). Covers authentication, CRUD, pagination, validation, and security checks across 51 requests and 123 scripted assertions.

📖 API Docs: [https://wger.de/api/v2/schema/ui](https://wger.de/api/v2/schema/ui)

🚀 QUICKSTART

1. Register a free account at [https://wger.de/en/user/registration](https://wger.de/en/user/registration)
    
2. Create an environment with `username` and `password` only
    
3. Run the collection with a 500 ms delay. TC-AUTH-01 logs in and saves the token automatically; tokens expire after 5 minutes.
    
4. Tests tagged \[KNOWN: BUG-XX\] fail on purpose. See the GitHub README for details.
    

Full documentation and findings: github.com/jojotrue/wger-qa-test-suite

⚠️ NOTE: wger rate-limits heavy usage. Space out Collection Runner executions.

item.name: Authentication
TC-AUTH-05 | POST Login – SQL Injection Attempt
TC-AUTH-07 | POST Refresh Token – Invalid Token
TC-AUTH-09 | GET Protected Endpoint – No Token [KNOWN: BUG-01]
TC-AUTH-10 | GET Protected Endpoint – Tampered JWT [KNOWN: BUG-01]
TC-AUTH-11 | POST Refresh Token – Documented Endpoint [KNOWN: BUG-02]

item.description: Login, token refresh, and token verification through wger’s current auth flow (`/allauth/app/v1/`). Covers valid and invalid credentials, empty and SQL-injection payloads, user-enumeration resistance, token rotation, and access to protected endpoints with missing or tampered tokens. TC-AUTH-01 saves the access token used by the rest of the suite; tokens expire after 5 minutes.

item.name: User Profile
TC-USER-02 | PATCH Update User Profile – Valid
TC-USER-03 | Mass Assignment – Try to Escalate to Trainer

item.description: Reads and updates the authenticated user’s profile (`/userprofile/`). Includes a mass-assignment check confirming that a user can’t promote themselves to staff, superuser, or trainer.

item.name: Routines
TC-ROUT-03 | GET Routine by ID – Valid

item.description: Full CRUD for user workout routines: create, read by ID, partial update, delete, and delete-again (404). Also covers pagination, a non-existent ID, and unauthenticated access. TC-ROUT-02 saves the new routine’s ID for the tests that follow.

item.name: Exercises (Public Endpoints)
TC-EX-01 | GET Exercise List – No Auth Required
TC-EX-02 | GET Exercise by ID – Valid
TC-EX-03 | GET Exercise by ID – Not Found
TC-EX-04 | GET Exercise List – Filter by Category
TC-EX-05 | GET Exercise List – Filter by Equipment

item.description: Public exercise data that requires no login: the exercise list, lookup by ID, a non-existent ID, filtering by category and equipment, plus exercise categories and muscles. TC-EX-01 saves a valid exercise ID for TC-EX-02.

item.name: Workout Sessions
TC-SESS-03 | GET Session by ID – Valid
TC-SESS-04 | POST Create Session – Invalid Date
TC-SESS-05 | GET Sessions – Ordered by Start Time

item.description: Create, read, order, and delete workout sessions using the current schema (`datetime_start` / `datetime_end`, UUID IDs). Includes an invalid-date negative test. TC-SESS-02 saves the new session’s ID for the tests that follow.

item.name: Weight Log
TC-WGHT-02 | POST Create Weight Entry – Valid
TC-WGHT-03 | POST Create Weight Entry – Negative Weight
TC-WGHT-04 | POST Create Weight Entry – Missing Date (defaults to now)

item.description: Create and list weight entries. Negative cases cover a negative weight value; a missing date is accepted and defaults to the current time.

item.name: Security Tests
TC-SEC-01 | BOLA – Access Another User's Routine (ID 1)
TC-SEC-02 | BOLA – Access Another User's Weight Entry (ID 1)
TC-SEC-03 | Expired JWT – Access Protected Route [KNOWN: BUG-01]
TC-SEC-04 | No Auth Header – Protected Route [KNOWN: BUG-01]
TC-SEC-06 | XSS Payload in Routine Name

item.description: Broken object-level authorization (accessing another user’s routine and weight entry), expired, missing, and malformed auth headers, an XSS payload in a routine name, and an oversized payload that checks the 25-character name limit. Test routines created here are deleted automatically.

item.name: API Health & Structure
TC-HLTH-01 | GET API Root – No Auth
TC-HLTH-02 | GET API Root – HTTPS Request, No Version Leak
TC-HLTH-03 | OPTIONS – Check Allowed Methods on Routine

exec: pm.test('No stack trace or internal error leaked', () => {

item.description: Baseline API checks: the root endpoint responds without auth and lists the main endpoints, requests go over HTTPS without exposing server version details, allowed methods are advertised via OPTIONS, and unknown endpoints return a clean 404 without leaking internals.
